operative_clauses.original_operative_text: it is hereby ordered, in the interest of the internal management of the Government, as follows:

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); operative words before the numbered sections

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1. The Office of Alien Property Custodian in the Office for Emergency Management of the Executive Office of the President, established by Executive Order No. 9095 of March 11, 1942, is hereby terminated; and all authority, rights, privileges, powers, duties, and other functions vested in such Office or in the Alien Property Custodian or transferred or delegated thereto are hereby vested in or transferred or delegated to the Attorney General, as the case may be, and shall be administered by him or under his direction and control by such officers and agencies of the Department of Justice as he may designate.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); para. 1

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 2. All property or interests vested in or transferred to the Alien Property Custodian or seized by him, and all proceeds thereof, which are held or administered by him on the effective date of this order are hereby transferred to the Attorney General.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); para. 2

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 3. Al personnel, property, records, and funds of the Office of Alien Property Custodian are hereby transferred to the Department of Justice.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); para. 3

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 4. This order supersedes all prior Executive orders to the extent that they are in conflict with this order.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); para. 4

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 5. This order shall become effective on October 15, 1946.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); para. 5
